# United World International

> A geopolitical news and analysis platform covering international relations, regional tensions, and expert commentary on global affairs.

United World International provides in-depth geopolitical analysis and news coverage with a focus on Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and US foreign policy. The platform features contributions from expert analysts and covers critical regional issues including Iran-US tensions, ASEAN dynamics, and NATO strategy.

## Key Topics

- Geopolitical Analysis
- International Relations
- Middle East Affairs
- Asia-Pacific Region
- Iran Conflict
- US Foreign Policy
- China
- Regional Tensions
- NATO Strategy
- ASEAN
- Türkiye
- Israel
- Strait of Hormuz
- Expert Contributors
- Global Affairs

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://uwidata.com): Homepage for United World International featuring geopolitical news and analysis
- [About Us](https://uwidata.com/about-us): Mission statement and overview of United World International's geopolitical platform
